title: Top 3 Must-Have Implements for New Tractor Owners

subtasks.text: Explain that the brush hog is a Titan implements medium duty model, six feet wide, and the most essential implement for brush clearance.
Highlight its versatility for clearing grass and brush on homesteads.
Identify a six-foot box blade made by Titan implements and its functions.
Emphasize its versatility and uses for clearing gravel, dirt roads, and making paths.
